title: Pressure flaking to serrate bifacial points for the hunt during the MIS5 at Sibudu Cave (South Africa)
lineage: Primary analysis of lowermost Sibudu points and bone-tool residues; the basal layers are undated and 77.3 ± 2.7 ka is a date on an overlying layer. Reported projectile and pressure interpretations are scoped to the studied objects.

passages.note: Abstract; Site context and stratigraphy; Evidence for pressure flaking; Hunting with points mounted on shafts; Discussion.
